entry.title: Should wallets default to Taproot or SegWit receive addresses while some services still reject bc1p?
entry.summary:
Gem Wallet has been included on [whentaproot.org](https://whentaproot.org), contributing to the resource's comprehensive and current listing of services supporting Taproot. The documentation for Gem Wallet now references this site, providing users with a reliable source to verify which platforms are compatible with Taproot technology.
Additionally, the updated documentation highlights Gem Wallet’s capability to send transactions to bc1p addresses, ensuring users are aware of its compatibility with these modern address formats. This integration and reference serve both as proof of Gem Wallet’s ongoing support for new Bitcoin features and as an educational guide for those seeking Taproot-enabled services.
